title: Da pacem Domine (La Rue)
desc: Pierre de la Rue, Da pacem Domine. 4 voices (Discantus, Contra, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue2003); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
